text: This report seeks: i) Approval from City Council as Approving Authority under the Expropriations Act, to expropriate a fee simple interest and a temporary easement (the "Property Interests") over part of the property municipally known as 50 Alma Avenue (the "Property"); ii) Approval for the City, as Expropriating Authority under the Expropriations Act, to serve associated notices and make statutory Offers of Compensation in accordance with the Expropriations Act. The Property Interests are required for the purpose of constructing the West Toronto Railpath Extension, which will improve cyclist and pedestrian connectivity and safety in the area. This report relates to the second stage of the expropriation process. City Council on October 1 and 4, 2021, adopted the following: 1.
